{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mul_subexpression(
    input [7:0] multiplicand,
    input [7:0] multiplier,
    output [15:0] product
);
    wire [15:0] row [0:7];
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin: gen_rows
            assign row[i] = {8'b0, (multiplier & {8{multiplicand[i]}})} << i;
        end
    endgenerate

    wire [15:0] s0, c0, s1, c1;
    wire [15:0] s2, c2, s3, c3;
    wire [15:0] s4, c4, s5, c5;

    mul_subexpression_csa u0(row[0], row[1], row[2], s0, c0);
    mul_subexpression_csa u1(row[3], row[4], row[5], s1, c1);
    mul_subexpression_csa u2(s0, c0, row[6], s2, c2);
    mul_subexpression_csa u3(s1, c1, row[7], s3, c3);
    mul_subexpression_csa u4(s2, c2, s3, s4, c4);
    mul_subexpression_csa u5(s4, c4, c3, s5, c5);

    assign product = s5 + c5;
endmodule

module mul_subexpression_csa(
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    input [15:0] c,
    output [15:0] s,
    output [15:0] carry
);
    assign s = a ^ b ^ c;
    assign carry = ((a & b) | (a & c) | (b & c)) << 1;
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The original serial accumulation places seven carry-propagating additions in the partial-product reduction path.",
  "rewrite": "Replace serial accumulation with six carry-save compressors arranged in four reduction levels, followed by a single final carry-propagating addition. Constant-zero partial-product positions remain available for synthesis simplification.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to substantially reduce maximum data arrival by eliminating repeated carry propagation during reduction. Exact mapped timing and electrical-violation results require evaluation with the specified flow.",

  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, unsigned port widths, and absence of parameters. Each shifted row exactly matches the original partial product. Every compressor preserves its input sum modulo 65536, including explicit carry truncation, so all 16 output bits match for every binary input combination. No storage, latency, assumptions, or undefined outputs are introduced."
